title: Expedite Fees, Order Cutoffs and Route Days by Ship-To Service Level
content:
For every Ship-To Fulfillment Account, the expedite charges, the booking cutoffs, the route schedule and the will-call hold period depend on the service level the ship-to holds. Times are ship-to local times.

| Service level | Expedite fee, next day air (USD per order) | Expedite fee, second day air (USD per order) | Expedited orders included per calendar month | Same-day cutoff (stocked orders) | Next day air cutoff | Route deliveries per week | Will-call hold (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 35.00 | 20.00 | 0 | 15:00 | 16:00 | 0 | 5 |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 30.00 | 18.00 | 0 | 16:00 | 16:30 | 0 | 5 |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | 20.00 | 12.00 | 2 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 0 | 7 |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 20.00 | 12.00 | 2 | 17:00 | 17:00 | 2 | 7 |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 10.00 | 6.00 | 4 | 18:00 | 17:30 | 3 | 10 |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 0.00 | 0.00 | 10 | 19:00 | 18:00 | 5 | 10 |

**Definitions carried by this schedule**

1. *Expedite fee, next day air* — the Corbett expedite fee per order shipped next day air, USD.
2. *Expedite fee, second day air* — the Corbett expedite fee per order shipped second day air, USD.
3. *Expedited orders included per month* — the number of expedited orders per calendar month per ship-to on which the expedite fee is not charged.
4. *Same-day cutoff* — the ship-to local time (HH:MM) by which a stocked order must be booked to ship the same business day.
5. *Next day air cutoff* — the ship-to local time (HH:MM) by which an order must be booked to leave the same day by next day air.
6. *Route deliveries per week* — the scheduled route truck deliveries per week; 0 means no route service.
7. *Will-call hold* — the calendar days an order staged for branch will-call pickup is held before it is restocked and cancelled.

**Points of reading**

- Only the three route levels carry route service; Corbett Parcel Ship-To, Corbett Standard Ship-To and Corbett Priority Ship-To show 0 route deliveries per week.
- At Corbett Parcel Ship-To and Corbett Standard Ship-To no expedited order in a month is included.
- At Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To both expedite fees are 0.00.
